Talis est luxuria. Corpus enim nostrū, quod
prius erat pacificum, convertitur in hostem.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Ief. 40" (possibly Ies.); "Eccles. 1ȝ" (number possibly 13); "lu-tofum" (word after line break, reading uncertain); "c[illegible]erit" in "Si c…erit forsitan" is unreadable (the scan shows a gap between c and erit). The bottom centre mark "1" is taken as a gathering signature. "bapti-" at bottom right is treated as a catchword. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept only where the word is broken at the line end. Text is set as one paragraph, continuing from the previous page.
